name: Mentors
description: A live-action children's television series following 15 year old Oliver Cates and his friend Dee who - using their homemade time machine- zap historical figures into their 21st century lives.

videos.title: The Genius
videos.overview: 14-year-old Oliver Cates inadvertently transports Albert Einstein into the present with his computer. Before going back, Einstein helps Oliver work through his anger so he can reconcile with his mother, whom the boy blames for his parents' divorce.

videos.title: Smart Aleck
videos.overview: Oliver has no one with whom he can share his secret, so he summons Alexander Graham Bell. However, his secret is uncovered by a curious 14-year-old named Dee Sampson who, thanks to Bell’s advice, Oliver eventually befriends.

videos.title: Raising the Siege
videos.overview: Dee is upset by her parents’ investment in a toxic pulp mill, so she summons Joan of Arc to help organize a protest, despite Oliver’s reservations.

videos.title: Lewis in Wonderland
videos.overview: Dee’s reticence to leave her childhood behind motivates her to summon writer Lewis Carroll, whose real name is Charles Dodgson, who helps her deal with her grandmother’s death.

videos.title: Little Emperor
videos.overview: Oliver summons Napoleon Bonaparte to help inspire his pals to win a newspaper subscription contest.

videos.title: Wilde Card
videos.overview: Oliver thinks he lacks “the right stuff” where his father is concerned and, at the same time, his friend Bobby is being bullied by the football jocks. With the witty Oscar Wilde as their guide, they both learn that it’s okay to be themselves.

videos.title: A Ninth of Beethoven
videos.overview: Oliver brings back Beethoven to help Dee deal with a pending operation that could result in her deafness. However, Beethoven is mistakenly brought back from a time when he isn’t deaf yet.

videos.title: A Transient, Shining Trouble
videos.overview: When Oliver plans on revealing his VisiCron technology to the world in return for fame and glory, Dee brings back the co-discoverer of insulin, Dr. Frederick Banting, whose own widespread fame in his day became nothing but an irritant.

videos.title: The Presence of Saint Nick
videos.overview: Mrs. Tatlow, an impoverished senior citizen, refuses to accept the groceries that Dee has volunteered to deliver over the Christmas holiday. Undaunted, Dee gets a scrooge-like Oliver to call back the real St. Nicholas to help her deliver the goods.

videos.title: The Raven
videos.overview: Dee brings in Edgar Allan Poe to help make a Halloween fundraising event spooky, but Poe is charming and anything but scary.

videos.title: Harriet's Path
videos.overview: Oliver wants to impress his father by winning a team “orienteering” contest: a race through wilderness terrain with only a compass and a map. For the team supervisor, Dee convinces Oliver to bring back Underground Railroad hero Harriet Tubman.

videos.title: The Crush
videos.overview: Dee convinces Oliver to summon Cleopatra to help her audition for a school production of Shakespeare’s Antony and Cleopatra. However, what she secretly wants is Cleo’s advice in winning the affections of school hunk Gino, who is auditioning for the part of Antony.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: When Oliver and Anne get lost hiking in the woods, Dee brings back Daniel Boone to help track them down.

videos.title: The Truth is in Here
videos.overview: Ghostly incidents are happening in the school. To help figure out who is responsible for them Oliver and Dee summon Sir Aurthur Conan Doyle. Oliver keeps questioning this punk looking girl who just seems to appear everywhere. Is she a ghost? Is she responsible for the ghostly incidents?

videos.title: Her Grace Under Pressure
videos.overview: Dee is running for Student Council but bad rumours about her are going around the school, so she summons Queen Elizabeth I for political advice.

videos.title: Dear Diary
videos.overview: Dee reads Anne Frank's diary entries and decides that Anne deserves 36 hours of free time from the attic hideaway. Anne Frank cannot believe how free it is where Dee and Oliver live from her attic hideaway. Anne starts to really like or should I say love Oliver. Dee and Oliver decide to take Anne to the movie theatre. During the movie Anne steps out of the theatre and meets this punk guy in the theatre's video arcade and finds that there's a lot of goodness in him. So that tought Dee and Oliver how to find goodness in people. At the end of the episode before Anne's 36 hours run out she says that it has been the best 36 hours she has ever had in her life.

videos.title: The Glory Trail
videos.overview: Oliver and Dee summon natve American Sacagawea to help in an expedition to expose a refinery that is secretly causing river pollution.

videos.title: Right Place, Right Time
videos.overview: Oliver accidentally causes himself and Dee to be transported back in time by 24 hours, giving them an opportunity to right a wrong.

videos.title: Nothing But Net
videos.overview: Dee summons the inventor of basketball, Dr. James Naismith, to coach her on winning an important game.

videos.title: Father's Day
videos.overview: After Oliver has a row with his dad, Dee brings the man forward in time as a teenager, hoping that they will learn to better relate to each other.

videos.title: The Book of Love
videos.overview: Oliver finds Dee being around this other guy a lot. Oliver decides to bring back Casanova because he thinks that he will be able to give him some tips on attracting girls. Unfortunately Casanova is giving Oliver really bad advice. When Oliver follows Casanova's advice, he makes a huge fool of himself.

videos.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
videos.overview: When a financial crisis causes Dee's mom to question her faith, Dee brings Moses from the past to advise her, not realizing that she has summoned the young Moses, when he was but a humble shepherd rather than a great leader.

videos.title: The Fire Ship
videos.overview: In danger of losing Visicron to a corporate software pirate, Oliver summons the famous 18th Century pirate Black Bart to help him fight fire with fire.

videos.title: Klondike Daze
videos.overview: Oliver adds another module to Visicron to speed it up. When Oliver tries to bring back Jack London, the Visicron instead takes Oliver to the time and place Jack London is right now. Oliver has to try and find a way back, so Dee asks Simon to help find a way to bring Oliver back. Meanwhile Oliver keeps altering the future and weird things keep happening in the present.

videos.title: Seer and Now
videos.overview: Plagued by a recurring dream, Dee summons famous prophet Nostradamus to advise her on what it means.

videos.title: Future Tense
videos.overview: Oliver is just about to delete Visicron before going to college, but then he is transported into the future by an old man. Oliver gets accused by the old man of being careless with time travel. Oliver and the old man watch clips of past episodes on a screen so that Oliver can defend himself and show the man what good Visicron has done. The old man convinces Oliver he shouldn't delete Visicron and then Oliver gets sent back to the present. We later find out that the old man was really Oliver himself as an old man in the future. In the end right before Oliver leaves to Montreal, Quebec, Canada to go to college he gives Visicron to his 12 year old cousin Simon.

videos.title: The Good, The Bad and the Ollie
videos.overview:
Simon brings Oliver back home from the university using the VisiCron to help him with an invention. But there is a glitch in the VisiCron and Oliver is split into two, one nice and the other one is naughty.

The nice one cannot tell a lie but the naughty one is seeking revenge on all the people that treated him bad in high school so Crystal and Simon need to find him before he does something really bad.

videos.title: Such Stuff As Dreams Are Made Of
The Tao of Hockey
videos.overview: Simon's hockey team isn't doing that well so he uses the time machine to bring confusious back to the present. At first the hockey team doesn't like him but after he teaches them a few things they are ready to play and win

videos.title: A Matter of Time (2)
videos.overview:
Simon, Crystal, and Glae try to retrieve the time machine after it's been stolen so they use a device to activate the time machine and bring back Harry Houdini.

Glae is getting headaches and starts to disappear, at a fast rate.

Thus, Simon must choose between the secrets and confidentiality of the time machine, and saving a friend from not existing.
